t: An open add-on board that turns a Raspberry Pi into a norns sound computer.
steps: Download the shield's open EAGLE files and parts list from monome's norns-shield repository.
Order the circuit boards and parts, or look for a used or community-built shield.
Get a Raspberry Pi 3B+, a good microSD card and a dedicated power supply of at least 2 amps.
Solder and assemble the shield onto the Pi, then add a case.
Flash the norns disk image that matches your shield's audio chip.
Expand the filesystem and connect to Wi-Fi from the norns menu.
Install a script from the community library and try the awake sequencer.
meta: Wild Open. From $270. A few stores.
